segments.text: proposition 1 THe children of Iſraell, when they paſſed the red ſea, came not to the other ſhore, which was right ouer againſt them.
proposition 2 They held their iornie by ſea, in the forme of a ſemicircle.
proposition 3 The ſea ſhore of the deſert Elim, from whence they departed, was the ſelfe-ſame with that wherevnto they arriued, albeit that the place of the ſhore were not all one.
